title: Which combo should come next?
author: maarkeez
selftext:
Hi! I'm making Tessavar, a free, open source, turn-based pixel-art RPG that runs in your browser, on phone or desktop. This week's update:

\- Effects that combine: water soaks you, and Thunder on a soaked unit stuns it for two turns instead of one. Lava burns, and being soaked halves the burn.  
\- A new side quest from the Alchemist, who sends you after that storm bat.  
\- A parchment look for the whole HUD, with bigger text for phones.

I'd love your feedback on two things:

\- Can you tell what each effect icon means at a glance?  
\- Which combo should come next?

The link to play is in the first comment.

On AI use: the party and the terrain are hand-drawn by me, the enemies and npcs are CC0 placeholder sprites, and I write the code with an AI coding assistant.
